1	# Patch Sloth: Build Specification
2	
3	> **For Claude Code.** This is the single source of truth for the project.
4	> - Read the whole document before writing code.
5	> - Work milestone by milestone (§15), and check each milestone's acceptance criteria before moving on.
6	> - Stop and ask the human whenever you reach a step tagged **[HUMAN]** (full list in §16).
7	> - Do not invent third-party API names. Where this spec says **VERIFY**, read the linked docs (or `--help`) first, then write the code.
8	> - Keep every decision you make in `DECISIONS.md`, one line each, with the date and the reason. The write-up depends on it.
9	
10	---
11	
12	## 1. One-paragraph summary
13	
14	Since April 2026, NIST's National Vulnerability Database (NVD) no longer analyses every CVE. Many CVEs are marked **Deferred**. For those, the only severity score is the one supplied by the **CNA**, the organisation that reported the vulnerability (often the vendor itself). In the years when NVD still reviewed CNA scores, it changed the CNA's CVSS vector about 4 in 10 times. When it changed the severity band, it raised it about 3 times more often than it lowered it.
15	
16	**Patch Sloth** gives a maintainer the missing second opinion for the CVEs in *their own* lockfile:
17	- It predicts what an independent NVD-style reviewer would likely have scored.
18	- It flags CVEs that are probably under-rated.
19	- It writes a one-minute "patch now / this month / ignore" report.
20	
21	It is built for the DEV Hacktoberfest 2026 Open-Source AI Challenge, Week 3 ("Slow and Steady": build something with open-source AI that rewards laziness). The due date is **Oct 25, 2026, 11:59 PM PDT**, which is Mon Oct 26, 12:29 PM IST.
22	
23	## 2. Evidence already measured (cite these; recompute in M1)
24	
25	These numbers come from NVD records 2021–2026, taken from the fkie-cad mirror on 2026-10-21.
26	
27	| Fact | Value |
28	|---|---|
29	| 2026 CVE IDs so far | 78,297 |
30	| Deferred | 28,518 (36%) |
31	| Deferred, Awaiting Analysis or Received (no NVD analysis) | 41,907 (54%) |
32	| Deferred per month (2026 IDs) | Mar 1,382 → Aug 5,196 → Sep 5,629 |
33	| Deferred CVEs with some CVSS score | 99.4% (almost all supplied by the CNA) |
34	| Deferred CVEs with an NVD score | 1.5% |
35	| Deferred CVEs with CPE configurations | 0 |
36	| 2024: NVD wrote its own vector on CNA-scored CVEs | 16,741 of 26,465. It changed the CNA vector in 11,252 (43% of all) and changed the severity band in 6,489. |
37	| 2025: when NVD changed the score, the score went up vs down | 6,419 vs 2,009 |
38	| Most disputed CVSS fields (2025) | C/I/A, disputed in 48–56% of the pairs where both NVD and the CNA scored. AV is disputed in only about 6%. |
39	| Biggest scorers of Deferred CVEs | VulDB, Patchstack, CISA-ADP (Vulnrichment), VulnCheck, GitHub, Wordfence |
40	| NVD writes its own score, share by month | 2024: 47–91% → 2026-H2: 11–13%. When it does, it differs from the CNA 80–95% of the time. |
41	| Total labelled dataset | 239,058 non-rejected CVEs. Splits: train 80,098 / val 11,655 / test 30,706. Deferred and unlabelled: 48,979. |
42	
43	**Honesty framing (required in all copy):**
44	- NVD is not ground truth. NVD tends to score the worst case. Daniel Stenberg of curl has argued that NVD inflates severity ([source](https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2023/03/06/nvd-makes-up-vulnerability-severity-levels/)).
45	- The product therefore says *"an independent NVD-style reviewer would likely rate this higher"*. It must never say *"the vendor is wrong"*.
46	- All outputs are **estimates for triage, not official scores**.
47	
48	## 3. Goals and non-goals
49	
50	**Goals**
51	1. A reproducible dataset and evaluation that judges can trust: time-based splits, baselines, confidence intervals and significance tests.
52	2. A Task-A model: a Tinker LoRA fine-tune of an open-weight model that predicts the NVD-style CVSS v3.1 vector.
53	3. A Task-B model: TabPFN, predicting P(NVD would raise the CNA's severity band). It also stacks the LLM's output with tabular features.
54	4. A product: a CLI, a web page and an API. Input is a lockfile; output is a report written by Ultramarine.
55	5. Deployment on DigitalOcean.
56	6. A daily open data feed: a second-opinion CSV covering every Deferred CVE.
57	7. A DEV post that explains the work, with charts and honest limits.
58	
59	**Non-goals (say so in the post)**
60	- Generating CPE (affected-product lists). This is future work.
61	- Beating EPSS at predicting exploitation. EPSS is used only as an input field.
62	- CVSS v4.0. We target v3.1 only, because that is what most CNAs and NVD provide.
63	- Ecosystems beyond npm and PyPI.
64	
65	## 4. Partner technology mapping
66	
67	| Partner | Role in Patch Sloth | Evidence to show in the post |
68	|---|---|---|
69	| **Tinker** (Thinking Machines) | LoRA SFT of `Qwen/Qwen3-8B` for Task A, using about 30k examples for 1 epoch. Also hosts base-model zero-shot sampling. | Base vs fine-tuned: JSON validity, per-field accuracy, bump-up recall and precision, McNemar against copy-CNA. Training loss curve. Cost. |
70	| **TabPFN** (Prior Labs) | Task B classifier, plus the stacking "decision layer" inside the triage agent. Prior Labs favours TabPFN inside a wider prediction agent. | PR-AUC with CIs against logistic regression and HistGBT. A scaling curve over `n_train`. Calibration plot. |
71	| **DigitalOcean** | App Platform hosts the FastAPI app and UI. A GPU Droplet runs vLLM with the LoRA adapter, for on-demand second opinions and the nightly feed job. | Architecture diagram, latency, hourly cost, screenshots. |
72	| **Ultramarine 1 Flash** (Paper Instruments) | Report writer, with tool calling if supported. Also a frontier-style zero-shot baseline on 1k test CVEs. | Cost per report (tokens × price), guardrail pass rate, baseline comparison. |
73	| **Entire** | Records every Claude Code session that builds this repo, on the `entire/checkpoints/v1` branch. | Link to the sessions in the post, and use `entire checkpoint explain` to show why key code exists. |
74	| *(optional)* **DevRelay** | Saves an agent transcript to DEV and embeds it in the post. The submission template asks for this. | An embedded transcript in the post. |
75	
76	Do not add more partners, for example simply to inflate the count. Four done well, plus Entire, is the strategy.
77	
78	## 5. Architecture
79	
80	```
81	                         ┌───────────── offline / nightly (GPU) ─────────────┐
82	 NVD mirror (fkie-cad) ──►  build_dataset ─► cves.parquet ─► Task A (Tinker LoRA, vLLM)
83	 CISA KEV  ─────────────►                         │            Task B (TabPFN)
84	 EPSS (daily CSV) ──────►                         ▼                    │
85	                                       feed/second_opinion.parquet ◄───┘
86	                                       (every Deferred/unanalysed CVE:
87	                                        cna_vector, predicted_vector, p_bump, epss, kev)
88	                         └───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
89	                                                  │ (uploaded nightly)
90	 user lockfile ─► osv-scanner (offline DB) ─► CVE IDs ─► lookup in feed ──► priority rules
91	                                                  │  (not in feed? → on-demand:
92	                                                  │   vLLM second opinion + HGB fallback)
93	                                                  ▼
94	                                     Ultramarine report agent ─► report.md / JSON / web page
95	```
96	
97	**Key design decision:**
98	- TabPFN is too slow to refit on a CPU web server for each request.
99	- So **all bump probabilities are precomputed nightly** for every Deferred, Awaiting Analysis and Received CVE, and stored in the feed.
100	- The web app only looks values up.
101	- CVEs newer than the last feed get an on-demand LLM second opinion plus the fast HistGBT fallback, and are labelled as such.

183	### 8.2 Label rule (Task A and Task B)
184	
185	For a CVE with status Analyzed or Modified **and** a CNA v3.1 vector:
186	- the label is the NVD Primary vector if NVD wrote one;
187	- otherwise the label is the CNA vector, because NVD reviewed it and kept it.
188	
189	**Use `isinstance(x, str)` checks, not truthiness.** A NaN-is-truthy bug already happened once and silently mislabelled about 40% of rows. Keep the regression test in §14.
190	
191	**Known caveat** (put it in the post): in 2026, NVD writes its own score much less often. Some "kept" labels may reflect lower review effort rather than agreement. Mitigation: report val (2025-H2) and test (2026) separately, and add a sensitivity analysis on Jan–Feb 2024, when NVD wrote its own score for about 91% of CVEs.
192	
193	### 8.3 Splits (time-based, never random)
194	
195	| Split | Rule |
196	|---|---|
197	| `train` | published before 2025-07-01 |
198	| `val` | 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31 |
199	| `test` | 2026-01-01 onwards |
200	| `deferred_unlabeled` | status Deferred with a CNA vector. This is the population the product scores. |
201	
202	Bump-up base rates: train 18%, val 23%, test 9%.
203	
204	### 8.4 Leakage rules (enforce in `features.py`, test in `tests/test_features.py`)
205	
206	Never use any of the following as features:
207	- `status`, because NVD prioritises KEV CVEs
208	- `nvd_vector`
209	- NVD's CWE (`weaknesses[type=Primary]`)
210	- NVD reference tags (NVD adds these during analysis)
211	- `configurations` / `has_cpe`
212	- `kev_date` (it is a report field only)
213	
214	Features must be computable for a Deferred CVE on the day it was published. Fit TF-IDF and SVD vocabularies on `train` only.

242	**Prompt.** `llm/prompt.py` holds the single shared definition for training and serving. Keep the `SYSTEM` prompt as written in `04`. The user turn contains:
243	- the CNA ID
244	- the CNA's CWE
245	- the CNA vector
246	- the description, truncated to 1,200 characters

251	- LoRA rank 32, learning rate 2e-4 with linear decay, batch 64, 1 epoch.

254	**API.**
255	- `scripts/05_tinker_train.py` uses `ServiceClient`, `create_lora_training_client`, `forward_backward(..., "cross_entropy")`, `optim_step(AdamParams)`, `save_weights_and_get_sampling_client` and `create_sampling_client`.
256	- **VERIFY every name against https://tinker-docs.thinkingmachines.ai before running.**
257	- Run `--dry_run` (128 examples) first. **[HUMAN]** supplies `TINKER_API_KEY`.
258	
259	**Evaluation sampling.**
260	- Greedy, `max_tokens=48`.
261	- `eval_n=8000` each for val and test, which costs about $2 in prefill.

267	2. `weights.build_lora_adapter(base_model=..., adapter_path=..., output_path="./peft_adapter")`

270	Source: https://tinker-docs.thinkingmachines.ai/tutorials/deployment/lora-adapter/

274	### 9.2 Task B: TabPFN bump classifier and stacking
275	
276	**Package.**
277	- Use the latest `tabpfn`. Prior Labs recommends **TabPFN-3.5**: open-weight and free after signing the non-commercial licence at platform.priorlabs.ai **[HUMAN]**.
278	- **VERIFY** how to select 3.5 weights and what their sample and feature limits are. Fallback is TabPFN-2.5 (Hugging Face `Prior-Labs/tabpfn_2_5`, which is tested up to 50k samples and 2k features).
279	- Run on the local GPU.
280	
281	**Features.** `features.py` is shared by training and serving:
282	- CNA vector fields as ordinal integers
283	- `cna_score`
284	- top-40 CNA codes and top-40 CWE codes
285	- `adp_scored`, `n_refs`, `ref_github`, `ref_exploitdb`, `desc_len`, `has_v40`
286	- 32-dimensional TF-IDF → SVD text embedding
287	
288	**Stacked features** (`--with_llm`):
289	- the fine-tuned LLM's predicted score minus the CNA score
290	- per-field "LLM changed this field" flags
291	
292	These must come from **out-of-SFT** predictions (`stack_train`) at training time, never from SFT training rows.
293	
294	**Training sizes.** Run `n_train` = 5k, 10k, 30k and 50k (within the limits). Plot PR-AUC against `n_train` as the scaling curve.
295	
296	**Calibration.** Report the Brier score and a reliability plot. If the model is miscalibrated, fit isotonic calibration on the first half of val and report on the second half.
297	
298	**Threshold τ.**
299	- Choose it on the **most recent 3 months of val** to match the 2026 base rate. Target: precision ≥ 0.5 in the top-flag set.
300	- Store τ in `config.py`.
301	
302	**Output.** `feed/second_opinion.parquet` with `p_bump` for every Deferred, Awaiting Analysis and Received CVE.
303	
304	**Bars to beat (test, 2026, base rate 0.093):**
305	
306	| Model | PR-AUC | 95% CI | Precision in top 10% |
307	|---|---|---|---|
308	| HistGBT | 0.58 | 0.56–0.60 | 0.53 |
309	| Logistic regression | 0.45 | — | — |

311	## 10. Evaluation protocol (results must be reproducible from `results/`)
312	
313	**Models on the same test rows** (val and test):
314	- copy-CNA
315	- TF-IDF + LR

349	- **[HUMAN]** reads them and tags each one: *model wrong*, *NVD worst-casing*, *ambiguous description*, or *label noise*.

357	> "On 2026 CVEs, Patch Sloth's top-10% flags were confirmed by NVD X% of the time vs a 9% base rate."

359	## 11. Product
360	
361	### 11.1 CLI (`patchsloth`, built with Typer)
362	
363	| Command | What it does |
364	|---|---|
365	| `scan PATH [--format md\|json] [--no-llm] [--no-report]` | Scan a lockfile or a project directory |

369	| `costs` | Summarise `results/costs.jsonl` |
370	
371	### 11.2 Scanning (`scan.py`)
372	
373	**Primary path:**
374	
375	```
376	osv-scanner scan source --offline --format=json --output-file=<tmp> <dir>
377	```
378	
379	- Use the offline DB cache, set by `OSV_SCANNER_LOCAL_DB_CACHE_DIRECTORY`. Download it once with `--offline-vulnerabilities --download-offline-databases`.
380	- For a single lockfile, **VERIFY** the current flag (v2 uses `-L/--lockfile`).

382	- Keep the package name, installed version and fixed version (if any).
383	
384	**Fallback** (if osv-scanner is not installed):
385	- A pure-Python matcher over the local GitHub Advisory DB clone.
386	- Parse `package-lock.json` (v2/v3 `packages`) and `requirements.txt` with `==` pins.
387	- Evaluate OSV `ranges[].events` (introduced/fixed/last_affected), using `packaging.version` for PyPI and the `semver` package for npm.
388	
389	**Fixtures:** in `tests/fixtures/`, include one npm lockfile and one requirements.txt with known-vulnerable pins. At least one of them must include a currently Deferred CVE; find one by joining the GitHub Advisory DB to `deferred_unlabeled`.
390	
391	### 11.3 Priority rules (`priority.py`, deterministic, explained in the report)
392	
393	For each CVE, compute `eff_sev = max(cna_sev, predicted_sev if p_bump ≥ τ else cna_sev)`. Then assign the first matching bucket:
394	
395	| Bucket | Rule |
396	|---|---|
397	| **P0 "Patch now"** | in KEV; **or** EPSS ≥ 0.10; **or** (eff_sev ≥ HIGH **and** p_bump ≥ τ_high **and** a fixed version exists) |
398	| **P1 "This month"** | eff_sev ≥ HIGH; **or** p_bump ≥ τ |
399	| **P2 "Ignore for now"** | everything else |
400	
401	Every row carries a machine-generated `reason` list, for example `["CISA KEV", "likely under-rated: CNA MEDIUM → predicted HIGH (p=0.82)", "fix: 4.17.21"]`. Tune τ_high on val and record it in `DECISIONS.md`.
402	
403	### 11.4 Report agent (`report.py`, Ultramarine 1 Flash)
404	
405	**Client.**
406	- OpenAI SDK with `base_url="https://api.paperinstruments.com/v1"` and `model="ultramarine-1-flash"`.
407	- API key in `PAPERINSTRUMENTS_API_KEY` **[HUMAN]**.
408	- Prices: $0.15/M input, $0.03/M cached input, $0.50/M output (as of 2026-10-15; **VERIFY**).
409	
410	**Agent shape.**
411	- The model receives the structured scan JSON. Rows are already prioritised; the model never sets priorities.
412	- Tools, if the endpoint supports OpenAI tool calling (**VERIFY**; otherwise inline everything):
413	  - `get_cve(cve_id)` returns the description, CNA vector and predicted vector
414	  - `explain_flag(cve_id)` returns the top TabPFN or HGB feature contributions (permutation importance or SHAP on HGB)
415	  - `similar_cves(cve_id, k=3)` returns past CVEs with the same CNA and CWE, together with what NVD did
416	
417	**Output.** Markdown:
418	1. a 3-line summary
419	2. a P0 table, then P1, then a collapsed P2 section
420	3. one plain-English reason per CVE
421	4. a footer stating that the scores are estimates, with the data dates

423	**Guardrail.**
424	- Extract every CVE ID and every number in the output and check that each appears in the input JSON.
425	- If the check fails, retry once. If it fails again, fall back to the Jinja template report.
426	- Log the pass rate.

443	- One static page served by FastAPI.

1	"""Parse NVD yearly feeds into one table: one row per CVE with the CNA's CVSS 3.1 vector,
2	NVD's own vector (if any), the training label, and serve-time-safe features.
3	
4	Label rule (Task A): for CVEs NVD has Analyzed/Modified and that carry a CNA v3.1 score:
5	  label = NVD Primary vector if NVD added one, else the CNA vector (NVD reviewed and kept it).
6	Evidence for the rule: since mid-2025, when NVD adds its own score it differs from the CNA 80-95%
7	of the time, i.e. NVD mostly writes its own score only when it disagrees (see results/label_check.txt).
8	"""
9	import glob, json, lzma, sys
10	from pathlib import Path
11	import pandas as pd
12	sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
13	from patchsloth.cvss import parse, base_score, sev_rank
14	
15	RAW = Path("data/raw")
16	CISA_ADP = "134c704f-9b21-4f2e-91b3-4a467353bcc0"
17	kev = {v["cveID"]: v["dateAdded"] for v in json.load(open(RAW / "kev.json"))["vulnerabilities"]}
18	
19	rows = []
20	for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(RAW / "CVE-*.json.xz"))):
21	    for c in json.load(lzma.open(f))["cve_items"]:
22	        status = c.get("vulnStatus")
23	        if status == "Rejected":
24	            continue
25	        m = c.get("metrics", {}).get("cvssMetricV31", [])
26	        prim = [x for x in m if x["type"] == "Primary"]
27	        sec = [x for x in m if x["type"] == "Secondary"]
28	        cna_src = c.get("sourceIdentifier", "")
29	        sec_cna = [x for x in sec if x["source"] == cna_src] or [x for x in sec if x["source"] == CISA_ADP] or sec
30	        cna_vec = sec_cna[0]["cvssData"]["vectorString"] if sec_cna else None
31	        nvd_vec = prim[0]["cvssData"]["vectorString"] if prim else None
32	        desc = next((d["value"] for d in c.get("descriptions", []) if d["lang"] == "en"), "")
33	        cna_cwes = sorted({d["value"] for w in c.get("weaknesses", []) if w.get("type") == "Secondary"
34	                           for d in w["description"] if d["value"].startswith("CWE-")})
35	        refs = [r["url"] for r in c.get("references", [])]
36	        rows.append(dict(
37	            cve=c["id"], published=c["published"][:10], status=status, cna=cna_src,

1	"""CVSS v3.1 helpers: parse vectors, compute base score, severity bands."""
2	import math
3	
4	METRICS = ["AV", "AC", "PR", "UI", "S", "C", "I", "A"]
5	VALUES = {
6	    "AV": ["N", "A", "L", "P"], "AC": ["L", "H"], "PR": ["N", "L", "H"],
7	    "UI": ["N", "R"], "S": ["U", "C"], "C": ["H", "L", "N"], "I": ["H", "L", "N"], "A": ["H", "L", "N"],
8	}
9	_W = {
10	    "AV": {"N": 0.85, "A": 0.62, "L": 0.55, "P": 0.2}, "AC": {"L": 0.77, "H": 0.44},
11	    "UI": {"N": 0.85, "R": 0.62}, "CIA": {"H": 0.56, "L": 0.22, "N": 0.0},
12	}
13	SEV = ["NONE", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "CRITICAL"]
14	
15	
16	def parse(vector: str) -> dict:
17	    parts = vector.split("/")
18	    if parts[0].startswith("CVSS:"):
19	        parts = parts[1:]
20	    d = dict(p.split(":") for p in parts)
21	    return {k: d[k] for k in METRICS}
22	
23	
24	def to_vector(m: dict) -> str:
25	    return "CVSS:3.1/" + "/".join(f"{k}:{m[k]}" for k in METRICS)
26	
27	
28	def _roundup(x: float) -> float:
29	    i = int(round(x * 100000))
30	    return i / 100000.0 if i % 10000 == 0 else (math.floor(i / 10000) + 1) / 10.0
31	
32	
33	def base_score(m: dict) -> float:
34	    changed = m["S"] == "C"
35	    pr = {"N": 0.85, "L": 0.68 if changed else 0.62, "H": 0.5 if changed else 0.27}[m["PR"]]
36	    iss = 1 - (1 - _W["CIA"][m["C"]]) * (1 - _W["CIA"][m["I"]]) * (1 - _W["CIA"][m["A"]])
37	    impact = 7.52 * (iss - 0.029) - 3.25 * (iss - 0.02) ** 15 if changed else 6.42 * iss
38	    expl = 8.22 * _W["AV"][m["AV"]] * _W["AC"][m["AC"]] * pr * _W["UI"][m["UI"]]
39	    if impact <= 0:
40	        return 0.0
41	    s = 1.08 * (impact + expl) if changed else impact + expl
42	    return _roundup(min(s, 10))
43	
44	
45	def severity(score: float) -> str:
46	    if score == 0: return "NONE"
47	    if score < 4: return "LOW"
48	    if score < 7: return "MEDIUM"
49	    if score < 9: return "HIGH"
50	    return "CRITICAL"
51	
52	
53	def sev_rank(score: float) -> int:
54	    return SEV.index(severity(score))

1	"""Shared evaluation for every Task A model, so all baselines are scored identically."""
2	import numpy as np
3	from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, precision_recall_fscore_support
4	from .cvss import METRICS, parse, base_score, sev_rank
5	
6	
7	def evaluate(df, pred_vectors, bump_proba=None, n_boot=1000, seed=0):
8	    """df needs label_vector, cna_vector, cna_sev, bump_up. pred_vectors: list of CVSS strings."""
9	    lab = [parse(v) for v in df.label_vector]
10	    pred = [parse(v) for v in pred_vectors]
11	    out = {f"acc_{k}": np.mean([p[k] == l[k] for p, l in zip(pred, lab)]) for k in METRICS}
12	    out["exact_vector"] = np.mean([p == l for p, l in zip(pred, lab)])
13	    ps = np.array([base_score(p) for p in pred]); ls = df.label_score.to_numpy()
14	    out["score_mae"] = np.abs(ps - ls).mean()
15	    psev = np.array([sev_rank(s) for s in ps]); lsev = df.label_sev.to_numpy()
16	    sev_ok = psev == lsev
17	    out["severity_acc"] = sev_ok.mean()
18	    y = df.bump_up.astype(bool).to_numpy()
19	    yhat = psev > df.cna_sev.to_numpy()
20	    p, r, f, _ = precision_recall_fscore_support(y, yhat, average="binary", zero_division=0)
21	    out.update(bump_precision=p, bump_recall=r, bump_f1=f, bump_base_rate=y.mean())
22	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); n = len(y)
23	    boots = {"severity_acc": [], "bump_f1": [], "bump_pr_auc": []}
24	    for _ in range(n_boot):
25	        i = rng.integers(0, n, n)
26	        boots["severity_acc"].append(sev_ok[i].mean())
27	        boots["bump_f1"].append(precision_recall_fscore_support(y[i], yhat[i], average="binary", zero_division=0)[2])
28	        if bump_proba is not None:
29	            boots["bump_pr_auc"].append(average_precision_score(y[i], bump_proba[i]))
30	    if bump_proba is not None:
31	        out["bump_pr_auc"] = average_precision_score(y, bump_proba)
32	    for k, v in boots.items():
33	        if v:
34	            out[f"{k}_ci95"] = (float(np.percentile(v, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(v, 97.5)))
35	    return out, sev_ok
36	
37	
38	def mcnemar(ok_a, ok_b):
39	    """Exact-ish McNemar (chi2 with continuity) on paired correctness arrays."""
40	    from scipy.stats import chi2
41	    b = int((ok_a & ~ok_b).sum()); c = int((~ok_a & ok_b).sum())
42	    stat = (abs(b - c) - 1) ** 2 / max(b + c, 1)
43	    return dict(a_only=b, b_only=c, p_value=float(chi2.sf(stat, 1)))

34	| test | 2026, after the policy change | 30,706 | 9% |

52	| Model | val | test |

54	| HistGBT, tabular | 0.90 | 0.58 |

61	- The headline metric is **ranking quality for bump-ups**: PR-AUC and precision of the top-k flags. The product is a "look at these first" ranker.

63	- The 2026 shift is a finding in its own right, not something to hide.

# Patch Sloth: tonight's plan (M0 → M1 on CPU → CPU-only parts of M5)

## Context
SPEC.md is the source of truth. Tonight I'm working on a Windows laptop with PowerShell, conda and no GPU. TabPFN and vLLM wait for tomorrow's workstation. The git root is `hacktoberFestweek3/patch-sloth/`, and the project itself lives in the nested `patch-sloth/` subfolder. I'll keep that layout. All paths below are relative to the inner `patch-sloth/`, and every command runs from there, because the scripts use the relative paths `data/` and `results/`.

## M0: repo hygiene, package refactor, tests → commit
- **Env:** `conda create -n patchsloth python=3.11`, then pip install. `requirements.txt` gets the CPU and product deps: pandas, pyarrow, scikit-learn, scipy, packaging, semver, jinja2, openai, fastapi, uvicorn, python-multipart, httpx, typer, python-dotenv, joblib, pytest, ruff, plus tinker and tinker-cookbook. `tabpfn` and torch move to a new `requirements-gpu.txt`, so I don't pull a large CPU torch build tonight. I'll log this in DECISIONS.md.
- **New modules** (refactors keep the behaviour byte-identical):
  - `patchsloth/config.py`: paths, `CISA_ADP`, split dates, model names, prices, τ/τ_high, and env reads via python-dotenv.
  - `patchsloth/data/nvd.py`: `parse_record(c, kev)`, `label_vector(status, cna_vector, nvd_vector)` (moved out of `02:47` with the `isinstance` checks kept), `add_labels(df)`, `assign_splits(df)`, `build_dataset(raw_dir)`.
  - `patchsloth/data/epss.py`: download plus a lookup by CVE. The URL gets VERIFIED first.
  - `patchsloth/features.py`: a `FeatureBuilder` holding `.fit(train_df)`, `.transform(df)` and `FORBIDDEN` (the §8.4 list). It covers the top-40 CNA/CWE categories, TF-IDF→SVD fitted on train only, and the CNA fields as ordinals. One change from `07`: today `07` builds its categorical codes with `pd.Categorical(...)` over the whole frame, so the same CNA could get a different code at serve time. FeatureBuilder fixes that with a stable vocabulary fitted on train, which is required for train/serve parity. This is a change, so it goes in DECISIONS.md and I'll re-check that the M1 numbers hold.
  - `patchsloth/llm/prompt.py`: `SYSTEM` (verbatim from `04`), `prompt(row)`, `target(row)`, and `parse_output(text, fallback)` that returns `(vector, valid)`. `parse_output` is lifted from the parsing logic in `06` and made tolerant of extra text.
  - `patchsloth/llm/backends.py`: the `LLMBackend` protocol, `NullBackend` (returns the CNA vector), and `get_backend()` via `PATCHSLOTH_LLM_BACKEND`. `VLLMBackend` and `TinkerBackend` get stubs that raise NotImplemented, to be filled in on the GPU day.
  - `patchsloth/tabular.py`: `train_bump(model, X, y)`, `predict_proba`, `save`/`load` (joblib to `data/models/`), and `choose_tau` on the last 3 months of val.
- **Scripts become thin entry points:** `02` → `data.nvd`, `07` → `features` + `tabular`, `04`/`06` → `llm.prompt`. Their CLI flags and output files stay the same. `03` keeps its own TF-IDF+LR, since that is a model and not a shared feature.
- **New files:** `DECISIONS.md` and `.env.example` (the §13 keys only), plus additions to `.gitignore` (`feed/`, `.env`, `osv-db/`).
- **Tests:** `tests/test_cvss.py` (≥6 vectors: 9.8, 6.1, 5.5, 9.0, one scope-changed, one zero-impact, plus the bands), `test_label_rule.py` (including the NaN/None regression in the same `float('nan')` shape that pandas produces), `test_features.py` (no forbidden columns, and train/serve parity on a fixture row), and `test_prompt.py`.

- I'll write `scripts/01_download.py` as a Python port of `01_download.sh`, using stdlib urllib and subprocess git, and keep the `.sh` file. Before writing it, I'll VERIFY that the EPSS host `epss.empiricalsecurity.com` still serves the file.

- **Commit "M1: …"** with `results/`.

## M5, CPU-only parts → commit
- **`scan.py`:**
  - The fallback GHSA matcher comes first: parse `package-lock.json` v2/v3 and `requirements.txt` `==` pins, then evaluate OSV `ranges[].events` with `packaging.version` (PyPI) and `semver` (npm) against `data/raw/advisory-database`.
  - Second, an osv-scanner wrapper, used if `scoop install osv-scanner` works. The flags get VERIFIED against `--help`.
  - Output rows: package, version, fixed version and CVE IDs.
- **`priority.py`:** the §11.3 rules exactly, with a `reason` list per row.
- **`report.py`:**
  - A Jinja template report and the guardrail (CVE IDs and numbers must appear in the input JSON), with retry-once-then-template.
  - The Ultramarine client goes through the OpenAI SDK. The Paper Instruments docs (base_url, model name, tool calling, prices) get VERIFIED first; if I can't reach them, I'll flag it.
  - With no key, the template is used.
  - `costs.py` logs to `results/costs.jsonl`.
- **`feed.py`:** HGB-only `feed build --no-llm`, which writes `feed/second_opinion.parquet` and `.csv` for Deferred, Awaiting Analysis and Received CVEs.
- **`api.py`:** FastAPI routes `/scan` (multipart, 2 MB cap), `/cve/{id}`, `/feed/latest.csv` and `/health`, plus a simple in-memory per-IP rate limiter (no extra dependency).
- **`cli.py`:** Typer commands `scan`, `cve`, `feed build`, `serve` and `costs`, plus a console-script entry in `pyproject.toml`.
- **`web/index.html`:** a textarea or file drop, a "data as of" date, the "estimates, not official" banner, and a mobile-friendly layout.
- **Tests and fixtures:**
  - Fixtures: a small `package-lock.json`, a `requirements.txt` and a mini advisory DB. At least one CVE must be currently Deferred, found by joining GHSA to `deferred_unlabeled`.
  - Tests: `test_scan.py`, `test_priority.py`, `test_report_guardrail.py` and `test_api.py` (NullBackend, mocked report). All must pass offline.
- **Commit "M5 (CPU): …"**.

## [HUMAN] stops I expect
- `PAPERINSTRUMENTS_API_KEY` in `.env`. Not blocking, because the template fallback works without it; you add the key later.
- If osv-scanner won't install via scoop, I'll give you the exact install command. The fallback matcher covers this in the meantime.
- TabPFN licence, Tinker key, vLLM and the Droplet are tomorrow's work and are skipped.

## Verification
- `conda run -n patchsloth pytest -q` stays green after each milestone, and so does `ruff check`.
- M1: `results/m1_reproduction.md` compares old vs new numbers.
- M5: `patchsloth scan tests/fixtures/package-lock.json --no-llm` prints a report. `patchsloth serve` runs, and a `curl` against `/health` and `/scan` checks it end to end.

"""NVD yearly feeds -> one row per CVE, the label rule (SPEC §8.2) and time-based splits (§8.3).

Label rule: for CVEs NVD has Analyzed/Modified that carry a CNA v3.1 vector,
label = NVD Primary vector if NVD wrote one, else the CNA vector (NVD reviewed and kept it).
Always test with isinstance(x, str): NaN is truthy, and a truthiness check once mislabelled ~40% of rows.
"""
import glob
import json
import lzma
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from ..config import CISA_ADP, LABELED_STATUSES, TEST_START, VAL_START
from ..cvss import base_score, parse, sev_rank


def load_kev(raw_dir: Path) -> dict:
    """CVE ID -> date added to CISA KEV."""
    with open(Path(raw_dir) / "kev.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return {v["cveID"]: v["dateAdded"] for v in json.load(f)["vulnerabilities"]}


def parse_record(c: dict, kev: dict) -> dict | None:
    """One NVD JSON 2.0 CVE item -> one dataset row (None for Rejected CVEs)."""
    status = c.get("vulnStatus")
    if status == "Rejected":
        return None
    m = c.get("metrics", {}).get("cvssMetricV31", [])
    prim = [x for x in m if x["type"] == "Primary"]
    sec = [x for x in m if x["type"] == "Secondary"]
    cna_src = c.get("sourceIdentifier", "")
    sec_cna = [x for x in sec if x["source"] == cna_src] or [x for x in sec if x["source"] == CISA_ADP] or sec
    cna_vec = sec_cna[0]["cvssData"]["vectorString"] if sec_cna else None
    nvd_vec = prim[0]["cvssData"]["vectorString"] if prim else None
    desc = next((d["value"] for d in c.get("descriptions", []) if d["lang"] == "en"), "")
    cna_cwes = sorted({d["value"] for w in c.get("weaknesses", []) if w.get("type") == "Secondary"
                       for d in w["description"] if d["value"].startswith("CWE-")})
    refs = [r["url"] for r in c.get("references", [])]
    if not sec_cna:
        score_source = None
    elif sec_cna[0]["source"] == cna_src:
        score_source = "CNA"
    elif sec_cna[0]["source"] == CISA_ADP:
        score_source = "CISA-ADP"
    else:
        score_source = "other"
    return dict(
        cve=c["id"], published=c["published"][:10], status=status, cna=cna_src, score_source=score_source,
        description=desc, cna_vector=cna_vec, nvd_vector=nvd_vec, cna_cwe=";".join(cna_cwes),
        n_refs=len(refs), ref_github=any("github.com" in u for u in refs),
        ref_exploitdb=any("exploit-db" in u or "packetstorm" in u for u in refs),
        has_v40=bool(c.get("metrics", {}).get("cvssMetricV40")), has_cpe=bool(c.get("configurations")),
        kev_date=kev.get(c["id"]),
    )


def label_vector(status, cna_vector, nvd_vector) -> str | None:
    """SPEC §8.2. Returns the label vector or None. Never use truthiness here (NaN is truthy)."""
    if status in LABELED_STATUSES and isinstance(cna_vector, str):
        return nvd_vector if isinstance(nvd_vector, str) else cna_vector
    return None


def add_labels(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Adds label_vector, {cna,label}_{score,sev}, bump_up, vector_changed, nvd_own."""
    df["label_vector"] = [label_vector(s, c, n) for s, c, n in zip(df.status, df.cna_vector, df.nvd_vector)]
    for col in ["cna", "label"]:
        v = df[f"{col}_vector"]
        df[f"{col}_score"] = v.map(lambda s: base_score(parse(s)) if isinstance(s, str) else None)
        df[f"{col}_sev"] = df[f"{col}_score"].map(lambda s: sev_rank(s) if pd.notna(s) else None)
    df["bump_up"] = (df.label_sev > df.cna_sev).where(df.label_vector.notna())
    df["vector_changed"] = pd.Series([parse(a) != parse(b) if isinstance(a, str) else None
                                      for a, b in zip(df.label_vector, df.cna_vector)], index=df.index)
    df["nvd_own"] = df.nvd_vector.notna()
    return df


def assign_splits(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """train < VAL_START <= val < TEST_START <= test; Deferred with a CNA vector -> deferred_unlabeled."""
    p = pd.to_datetime(df.published)
    df["split"] = None
    lab = df.label_vector.notna()
    df.loc[lab & (p < VAL_START), "split"] = "train"
    df.loc[lab & (p >= VAL_START) & (p < TEST_START), "split"] = "val"
    df.loc[lab & (p >= TEST_START), "split"] = "test"
    df.loc[(df.status == "Deferred") & df.cna_vector.notna(), "split"] = "deferred_unlabeled"
    return df


def build_dataset(raw_dir: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Parse every data/raw/CVE-*.json.xz feed into the cves.parquet table (SPEC §8.1)."""
    kev = load_kev(raw_dir)
    rows = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(Path(raw_dir) / "CVE-*.json.xz"))):
        with lzma.open(f) as fh:
            for c in json.load(fh)["cve_items"]:
                r = parse_record(c, kev)
                if r is not None:
                    rows.append(r)
    return assign_splits(add_labels(pd.DataFrame(rows)))

"""Parse NVD yearly feeds into one table: one row per CVE with the CNA's CVSS 3.1 vector,

input.content:
"""Tabular features for the bump classifier, shared by training (scripts/07) and serving (feed, api).

Leakage rules (SPEC §8.4): every feature must be computable for a Deferred CVE on the day it was
published. FeatureBuilder only ever reads INPUT_COLUMNS; tests/test_features.py checks that none of
them is in FORBIDDEN. TF-IDF/SVD and the top-k category vocabularies are fitted on train only.
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

from .cvss import METRICS, VALUES, base_score, parse

# NVD-side or post-analysis information, plus the labels themselves
FORBIDDEN = {
    "status", "nvd_vector", "nvd_cwe", "nvd_ref_tags", "configurations", "has_cpe", "kev_date",
    "label_vector", "label_score", "label_sev", "bump_up", "vector_changed", "nvd_own", "split",
}
INPUT_COLUMNS = ["cna", "cna_vector", "cna_cwe", "score_source", "description", "n_refs",
                 "ref_github", "ref_exploitdb", "has_v40"]
LLM_INPUT = "llm_vector"  # optional, only with with_llm=True; must come from out-of-SFT predictions


def _first_cwe(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return s.fillna("").astype(str).str.split(";").str[0]


class FeatureBuilder:
    """fit(train_df) then transform(any_df). transform is row-wise, so train/serve features match."""

    def __init__(self, top_k: int = 40, n_text: int = 32, with_llm: bool = False):
        self.top_k, self.n_text, self.with_llm = top_k, n_text, with_llm

    def fit(self, train: pd.DataFrame) -> "FeatureBuilder":
        top_cna = list(train.cna.value_counts().index[:self.top_k])
        top_cwe = list(_first_cwe(train.cna_cwe).value_counts().index[:self.top_k])
        # sorted vocab with "other" reproduces the pd.Categorical codes the original 07 used
        self.cna_vocab = sorted(set(top_cna) | {"other"})
        self.cwe_vocab = sorted(set(top_cwe) | {"other"})
        self.tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(min_df=5, max_features=30000, sublinear_tf=True).fit(train.description)
        self.svd = TruncatedSVD(self.n_text, random_state=0).fit(self.tfidf.transform(train.description))
        return self

    @property
    def feature_names(self) -> list[str]:
        names = [f"cna_{k}" for k in METRICS] + ["cna_score", "cna_id", "cwe", "adp_scored", "n_refs",
                                                 "ref_github", "ref_exploitdb", "desc_len", "has_v40"]
        names += [f"txt{i}" for i in range(self.n_text)]
        if self.with_llm:
            names += ["llm_score_delta"] + [f"llm_changed_{k}" for k in METRICS]
        return names

    def transform(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df[INPUT_COLUMNS + ([LLM_INPUT] if self.with_llm and LLM_INPUT in df else [])]
        X = pd.DataFrame(index=d.index)
        cna = d.cna_vector.map(lambda v: parse(v) if isinstance(v, str) else None)
        for k in METRICS:
            X[f"cna_{k}"] = cna.map(lambda m, k=k: VALUES[k].index(m[k]) if m else np.nan)
        cna_score = cna.map(lambda m: base_score(m) if m else np.nan)
        X["cna_score"] = cna_score
        cna_id = d.cna.where(d.cna.isin(self.cna_vocab), "other")
        X["cna_id"] = cna_id.map(self.cna_vocab.index)
        cwe = _first_cwe(d.cna_cwe)
        X["cwe"] = cwe.where(cwe.isin(self.cwe_vocab), "other").map(self.cwe_vocab.index)
        X["adp_scored"] = (d.score_source == "CISA-ADP").astype(int)
        X["n_refs"] = d.n_refs
        X["ref_github"] = d.ref_github.astype(int)
        X["ref_exploitdb"] = d.ref_exploitdb.astype(int)
        desc = d.description.fillna("")
        X["desc_len"] = desc.str.len()
        X["has_v40"] = d.has_v40.astype(int)
        emb = self.svd.transform(self.tfidf.transform(desc))
        for i in range(emb.shape[1]):
            X[f"txt{i}"] = emb[:, i]
        if self.with_llm:
            llm = d[LLM_INPUT].map(lambda v: parse(v) if isinstance(v, str) else None) \
                if LLM_INPUT in d else pd.Series(None, index=d.index, dtype=object)
            X["llm_score_delta"] = [base_score(m) - s if m and c else np.nan
                                    for m, c, s in zip(llm, cna, cna_score)]
            for k in METRICS:
                X[f"llm_changed_{k}"] = [float(m[k] != c[k]) if m and c else np.nan for m, c in zip(llm, cna)]
        return X[self.feature_names]

"""TabPFN decision layer: P(independent reviewer would raise the CNA's severity band).
Features are all available at serve time for Deferred CVEs (patchsloth/features.py). Optionally stacks
the fine-tuned LLM's predicted vector as features (--with_llm). Compares TabPFN vs logistic regression vs HistGBT.
Usage: python scripts/07_tabpfn_bump.py --model tabpfn --n_train 10000 [--with_llm]
With --model hgb it also saves data/models/bump_hgb.joblib (serve-time fallback) and results/thresholds.json."""
import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, brier_score_loss, roc_auc_score

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from patchsloth import tabular  # noqa: E402
from patchsloth.features import LLM_INPUT, FeatureBuilder  # noqa: E402

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--model", default="tabpfn", choices=["tabpfn", "hgb", "logreg"])
ap.add_argument("--n_train", type=int, default=10000)
ap.add_argument("--with_llm", action="store_true")
a = ap.parse_args()

df = pd.read_parquet("data/cves.parquet")
df = df[df.split.isin(["train", "val", "test", "deferred_unlabeled"])].copy()
if a.with_llm:  # out-of-SFT LLM predictions only (stack_train for training rows), SPEC §9.2
    v = {}
    for split in ["stack_train", "val", "test"]:
        p = Path(f"results/llm_vectors_ft_{split}.json")
        if p.exists():
            v.update(json.loads(p.read_text()))
    df[LLM_INPUT] = df.cve.map(v)
    if "stack_train" not in {p.stem.rsplit("_", 1)[-1] for p in Path("results").glob("llm_vectors_ft_*.json")}:
        print("NOTE: --with_llm needs results/llm_vectors_ft_stack_train.json (out-of-SFT train predictions)")

fb = FeatureBuilder(with_llm=a.with_llm).fit(df[df.split == "train"])
X = fb.transform(df)
y = df.bump_up
tr = df.split == "train"
if a.with_llm:  # train only on rows that have an out-of-SFT LLM prediction
    tr &= df[LLM_INPUT].notna()
idx = df[tr].sample(n=min(a.n_train, int(tr.sum())), random_state=0).index
clf = tabular.fit(a.model, X.loc[idx], y.loc[idx])
tag = a.model + ("_llm" if a.with_llm else "")


def predict(mask):
    return tabular.predict_proba(clf, X[mask])


out = {}
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
for split in ["val", "test"]:
    m = (df.split == split).to_numpy()
    p = predict(m)
    yy = y[m].astype(int).to_numpy()
    k = max(1, int(0.1 * len(p)))
    top = np.argsort(-p)[:k]
    boots = [average_precision_score(yy[i], p[i]) for i in (rng.integers(0, len(p), len(p)) for _ in range(500))]
    out[split] = dict(n=int(m.sum()), base_rate=yy.mean(), pr_auc=average_precision_score(yy, p),
                      pr_auc_ci95=(np.percentile(boots, 2.5), np.percentile(boots, 97.5)),
                      roc_auc=roc_auc_score(yy, p), brier=brier_score_loss(yy, p),
                      precision_at_top10pct=yy[top].mean())
    if split == "val":
        # thresholds on the most recent 3 months of val, closest to the 2026 base rate (SPEC §9.2)
        pub = df.published[m].to_numpy()
        recent = pub >= str((pd.Timestamp(df.published[m].max()) - pd.DateOffset(months=3)).date())
        tau = tabular.choose_tau(yy[recent], p[recent], min_precision=0.5)
        tau_high = max(tau, tabular.choose_tau(yy[recent], p[recent], min_precision=0.75))
        thr = dict(tau=tau, tau_high=tau_high, model=tag, tuned_on=f"val published >= {pub[recent].min()}",
                   n_tune=int(recent.sum()), base_rate_tune=float(yy[recent].mean()))
    else:
        flag = p >= thr["tau"]
        out[split]["recall_at_tau"] = float(yy[flag].sum() / max(yy.sum(), 1))
        out[split]["precision_at_tau"] = float(yy[flag].mean()) if flag.any() else 0.0
    print(split, {k_: (np.round(v_, 3) if not isinstance(v_, tuple) else tuple(np.round(v_, 3)))
                  for k_, v_ in out[split].items()})
out["thresholds"] = thr
print("thresholds", thr)
# score the real target population: Deferred CVEs nobody independently checked
m = (df.split == "deferred_unlabeled").to_numpy()
pd.DataFrame({"cve": df.cve[m], "cna": df.cna[m], "cna_vector": df.cna_vector[m], "p_bump": predict(m)}) \
  .sort_values("p_bump", ascending=False).to_csv(f"results/deferred_scored_{tag}.csv", index=False)
json.dump(out, open(f"results/bump_{tag}.json", "w"), indent=1, default=float)
if a.model == "hgb" and not a.with_llm:  # the CPU serve-time fallback
    print("saved", tabular.BumpModel(fb, clf, "hgb").save())
    Path("results/thresholds.json").write_text(json.dumps(thr, indent=1))

            continue
        preds = [json.loads(line) for line in open(p)]
        d = df.loc[[x["cve"] for x in preds]]

        vecs = [v for v, _ in parsed]
        r, ok = evaluate(d, vecs)
        r["json_valid"] = sum(ok_ for _, ok_ in parsed) / len(preds)
        _, ok_copy = evaluate(d, list(d.cna_vector), n_boot=0)
        r["mcnemar_vs_copy_cna_severity"] = mcnemar(ok, ok_copy)
        res[tag] = r
        Path(f"results/llm_vectors_{tag}_{split}.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(zip(d.index, vecs))))
    json.dump(res, open(f"results/llm_{split}.json", "w"), indent=1, default=float)

"""EPSS scores (FIRST / Empirical Security). Report field only, never a model feature.
Daily file: https://epss.empiricalsecurity.com/epss_scores-current.csv.gz (history: epss_scores-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.gz).
The CSV starts with a '#model_version:...,score_date:...' comment line, then cve,epss,percentile."""
import gzip
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from ..config import RAW

BASE = "https://epss.empiricalsecurity.com"


def url(date: str | None = None) -> str:
    return f"{BASE}/epss_scores-{date or 'current'}.csv.gz"


def download(date: str | None = None, out_dir: Path = RAW) -> Path:
    out = Path(out_dir) / ("epss_current.csv.gz" if date is None else f"epss_{date}.csv.gz")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url(date), out)
    return out


def load(path: Path = RAW / "epss_current.csv.gz") -> tuple[dict, str | None]:
    """Returns ({cve: epss}, score_date). Empty dict if the file is missing."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.exists():
        return {}, None
    with gzip.open(path, "rt") as f:
        header = f.readline()
    score_date = next((p.split(":", 1)[1][:10] for p in header.lstrip("#").strip().split(",")
                       if p.startswith("score_date")), None)
    df = pd.read_csv(path, comment="#")
    return dict(zip(df.cve, df.epss.astype(float))), score_date

"""Token / latency / dollar logging for every paid call -> results/costs.jsonl (SPEC §11.4)."""
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from .config import RESULTS, ULTRAMARINE_PRICE

COSTS_FILE = RESULTS / "costs.jsonl"


def dollars(input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int, cached_input_tokens: int = 0,
            price: dict = ULTRAMARINE_PRICE) -> float:
    uncached = max(input_tokens - cached_input_tokens, 0)
    return (uncached * price["input"] + cached_input_tokens * price["cached_input"]
            + output_tokens * price["output"]) / 1e6


def log(service: str, model: str, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int, latency_s: float,
        usd: float, path: Path = COSTS_FILE, **extra) -> dict:
    rec = dict(ts=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), service=service, model=model,
               input_tokens=input_tokens, output_tokens=output_tokens,
               latency_s=round(latency_s, 3), usd=round(usd, 6), **extra)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
    return rec


def summarise(path: Path = COSTS_FILE) -> dict:
    """Totals per (service, model) plus the guardrail pass rate where logged."""
    out: dict = {}
    if not Path(path).exists():
        return out
    for line in open(path, encoding="utf-8"):
        r = json.loads(line)
        k = f"{r['service']}/{r['model']}"
        s = out.setdefault(k, dict(calls=0, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, usd=0.0, latency_s=0.0,
                                   guardrail_pass=0, guardrail_checked=0))
        s["calls"] += 1
        s["input_tokens"] += r["input_tokens"]
        s["output_tokens"] += r["output_tokens"]
        s["usd"] += r["usd"]
        s["latency_s"] += r["latency_s"]
        if "guardrail_ok" in r:
            s["guardrail_checked"] += 1
            s["guardrail_pass"] += int(r["guardrail_ok"])
    for s in out.values():
        s["mean_latency_s"] = s["latency_s"] / s["calls"]
        s["usd_per_call"] = s["usd"] / s["calls"]
    return out

CNA = "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N"   # 5.4 MEDIUM

def test_analyzed_with_nvd_vector_uses_nvd():

    assert label_vector("Modified", CNA, NVD) == NVD

@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["Deferred", "Awaiting Analysis", "Received", "Undergoing Analysis"])
def test_unanalysed_has_no_label(status):

@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing", [None, float("nan"), np.nan, pd.NA])

    assert label_vector("Analyzed", missing, NVD) is None
    assert label_vector("Analyzed", missing, missing) is None
    assert label_vector("Analyzed", CNA, missing) == CNA


def test_nan_regression_through_dataframe():
    """Missing values as pandas actually stores them after a parquet round trip."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(dict(
        cve=["A", "B", "C", "D"], published=["2024-01-01", "2025-08-01", "2026-02-01", "2026-03-01"],
        status=["Analyzed", "Analyzed", "Analyzed", "Deferred"],
        cna_vector=[CNA, CNA, np.nan, CNA], nvd_vector=[NVD, np.nan, NVD, np.nan],
    ))
    df = assign_splits(add_labels(df))
    assert list(df.label_vector[:2]) == [NVD, CNA]
    assert df.label_vector[2:].isna().all()
    assert df.bump_up[0] == True and df.bump_up[1] == False  # noqa: E712
    assert pd.isna(df.bump_up[2]) and pd.isna(df.bump_up[3])
    assert list(df.split) == ["train", "val", None, "deferred_unlabeled"]

"""Leakage rules (SPEC §8.4) and train/serve feature parity."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pytest

from patchsloth.features import FORBIDDEN, INPUT_COLUMNS, FeatureBuilder

WORDS = ("sql injection remote attacker execute arbitrary code cross site scripting buffer overflow "
         "denial service authentication bypass path traversal privilege escalation plugin wordpress").split()
VECS = ["CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H", "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N",
        "CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N"]


def _df(n=60, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    return pd.DataFrame(dict(
        cve=[f"CVE-2024-{i}" for i in range(n)],
        cna=rng.choice(["cna-a", "cna-b", "cna-c"], n),
        cna_vector=rng.choice(VECS, n),
        cna_cwe=rng.choice(["CWE-79", "CWE-89;CWE-20", ""], n),
        score_source=rng.choice(["CNA", "CISA-ADP"], n),
        description=[" ".join(rng.choice(WORDS, 12)) for _ in range(n)],
        n_refs=rng.integers(0, 9, n), ref_github=rng.random(n) > .5, ref_exploitdb=rng.random(n) > .8,
        has_v40=rng.random(n) > .5,
        # forbidden columns present on purpose: the builder must not read them
        status="Analyzed", nvd_vector=VECS[0], has_cpe=True, kev_date="2024-01-01", bump_up=True,
    ))


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def fb():
    return FeatureBuilder(n_text=4, min_df=1).fit(_df())


def test_inputs_and_features_exclude_forbidden(fb):
    assert not set(INPUT_COLUMNS) & FORBIDDEN
    assert not set(fb.feature_names) & FORBIDDEN
    for spec_forbidden in ["status", "nvd_vector", "has_cpe", "kev_date", "configurations"]:
        assert spec_forbidden in FORBIDDEN


def test_transform_needs_only_input_columns(fb):
    d = _df(10, seed=1)
    full = fb.transform(d)
    minimal = fb.transform(d[INPUT_COLUMNS])
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(full, minimal)


def test_forbidden_columns_do_not_change_features(fb):
    d = _df(10, seed=2)
    d2 = d.assign(status="Deferred", nvd_vector=None, has_cpe=False, kev_date=None, bump_up=False)
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(fb.transform(d), fb.transform(d2))


def test_train_serve_parity_single_row(fb):
    """A row scored alone (serve) gets exactly the features it got inside the batch (train)."""
    batch = _df(20, seed=3)
    X_batch = fb.transform(batch)
    row = batch.iloc[[7]][INPUT_COLUMNS].reset_index(drop=True)
    X_row = fb.transform(row)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(X_row.to_numpy(float), X_batch.iloc[[7]].to_numpy(float))


def test_unseen_cna_maps_to_other(fb):
    d = _df(3, seed=4).assign(cna="never-seen")
    assert (fb.transform(d).cna_id == fb.cna_vocab.index("other")).all()


def test_with_llm_features():
    fb = FeatureBuilder(n_text=4, min_df=1, with_llm=True).fit(_df())
    d = _df(3, seed=5).assign(cna_vector=VECS[2], llm_vector=[VECS[0], VECS[2], None])
    X = fb.transform(d)
    assert X.llm_score_delta.iloc[0] == pytest.approx(9.8 - 5.5)
    assert X.llm_changed_C.iloc[0] == 0.0 and X.llm_changed_I.iloc[0] == 1.0
    assert X.llm_score_delta.iloc[1] == 0.0
    assert np.isnan(X.llm_score_delta.iloc[2])

"""Cross-platform port of 01_download.sh (Windows has no bash by default). Run from repo root. ~150 MB.
Downloads the NVD yearly feeds (fkie-cad mirror), CISA KEV, the GitHub Advisory DB (sparse clone of
github-reviewed advisories) and today's EPSS scores, and stamps results/data_as_of.txt."""
import datetime as dt
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from patchsloth.data import epss  # noqa: E402

RAW = Path("data/raw")
RAW.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def get(url: str, out: Path) -> None:
    print("GET", url)
    tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".part")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, tmp)
    tmp.replace(out)


for y in range(2021, 2027):
    get(f"https://github.com/fkie-cad/nvd-json-data-feeds/releases/latest/download/CVE-{y}.json.xz",
        RAW / f"CVE-{y}.json.xz")
get("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cisagov/kev-data/develop/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json",
    RAW / "kev.json")

# GitHub Advisory Database (what Dependabot uses): npm + PyPI reviewed advisories, with CVE aliases
adb = RAW / "advisory-database"
if shutil.which("git"):
    if not adb.exists():
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", "--sparse",
                        "https://github.com/github/advisory-database.git", str(adb)], check=True)
    else:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(adb), "pull", "--depth", "1"], check=False)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(adb), "sparse-checkout", "set", "advisories/github-reviewed"], check=True)
else:
    print("git not found: skipping the advisory database (needed by the fallback scanner)")

try:
    print("EPSS ->", epss.download())
except Exception as e:  # optional, report field only
    print("EPSS download failed (optional):", e)

Path("results").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path("results/data_as_of.txt").write_text(dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ") + "\n")
print("done")

input.content:
"""Nightly feed (SPEC §5, §9.2): second opinions for every unanalysed CVE, plus the lookup table the
serve path uses for every scanned CVE.

feed/second_opinion.parquet  one row per CVE in the dataset:
  source = "model"  Deferred / Awaiting Analysis / Received with a CNA vector: p_bump + predicted_vector
  source = "nvd"    NVD analysed it: predicted_vector = the NVD-final vector (label rule), no p_bump
  source = "none"   no CNA v3.1 vector to second-guess
feed/latest.csv              the open data feed: source == "model" rows only, without descriptions
"""
import json
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from . import config
from .cvss import base_score, parse, severity
from .data import epss as epss_mod
from .data.nvd import label_vector, parse_record
from .llm.backends import get_backend
from .tabular import BumpModel

FEED_FILE = config.FEED / "second_opinion.parquet"
CSV_FILE = config.FEED / "latest.csv"
META_FILE = config.FEED / "meta.json"
NVD_API = "https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId={}"
COLUMNS = ["cve", "published", "status", "cna", "cna_cwe", "score_source", "description", "cna_vector",
           "predicted_vector", "p_bump", "source", "llm_backend", "epss", "kev_date", "n_refs", "ref_github",
           "ref_exploitdb", "has_v40"]


def _sev(v):
    return severity(base_score(parse(v))) if isinstance(v, str) else None


def score_rows(df: pd.DataFrame, model: BumpModel | None, backend=None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Adds predicted_vector, p_bump, source to rows shaped like cves.parquet (or parse_record output)."""
    df = df.copy()
    backend = backend or get_backend("null")
    unanalysed = df.status.isin(config.UNANALYSED_STATUSES) & df.cna_vector.map(lambda v: isinstance(v, str))
    labels = [label_vector(s, c, n) for s, c, n in zip(df.status, df.cna_vector, df.get("nvd_vector", None)
                                                       if "nvd_vector" in df else [None] * len(df))]
    df["predicted_vector"] = labels
    df["p_bump"] = np.nan
    df["source"] = np.where(pd.Series(labels, index=df.index).notna(), "nvd", "none")
    if unanalysed.any():
        u = df[unanalysed]
        df.loc[unanalysed, "predicted_vector"] = backend.predict_vectors(list(u.itertuples()))
        if model is not None:
            df.loc[unanalysed, "p_bump"] = model.predict(u)
        df.loc[unanalysed, "source"] = "model"
    df["llm_backend"] = np.where(df.source == "model", backend.name, None)
    return df


def build(since: str | None = None, model_name: str = "hgb", no_llm: bool = True,
          dataset: Path = config.CVES_PARQUET, out_dir: Path = config.FEED) -> dict:
    """Score the dataset and write the feed. `since` limits the CSV to CVEs published on/after a date."""
    df = pd.read_parquet(dataset)
    model = BumpModel.load(name=model_name)
    backend = get_backend("null" if no_llm else None)
    scores, score_date = epss_mod.load()
    df["epss"] = df.cve.map(scores)
    df = score_rows(df, model, backend)
    out_dir = Path(out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df[COLUMNS].to_parquet(out_dir / FEED_FILE.name, index=False)
    pub = df[df.source == "model"]
    if since:
        pub = pub[pub.published >= since]
    pub = pub.assign(cna_severity=pub.cna_vector.map(_sev), predicted_severity=pub.predicted_vector.map(_sev))
    pub = pub.sort_values("p_bump", ascending=False)
    pub[["cve", "published", "status", "cna", "cna_vector", "cna_severity", "predicted_vector",
         "predicted_severity", "p_bump", "llm_backend", "epss", "kev_date"]] \
        .to_csv(out_dir / CSV_FILE.name, index=False, float_format="%.4f")
    as_of = (config.RESULTS / "data_as_of.txt")
    meta = dict(data_as_of=as_of.read_text().strip() if as_of.exists() else None, epss_date=score_date,
                model=model_name, llm_backend=backend.name, thresholds=config.thresholds(),
                n_rows=len(df), n_model=int((df.source == "model").sum()), n_csv=len(pub))
    (out_dir / META_FILE.name).write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=1, default=float))
    return meta


class Feed:
    """Serve-time lookups. Loads the feed once; CVEs missing from it can be fetched from the NVD API."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path = FEED_FILE):
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.df = pd.read_parquet(self.path).set_index("cve") if self.path.exists() else None
        meta = self.path.parent / META_FILE.name
        self.meta = json.loads(meta.read_text()) if meta.exists() else {}
        self._model = None

    @property
    def data_as_of(self) -> str | None:
        return self.meta.get("data_as_of")

    def model(self) -> BumpModel | None:
        if self._model is None:
            try:
                self._model = BumpModel.load(name=self.meta.get("model", "hgb"))
            except FileNotFoundError:
                return None
        return self._model

    def get(self, cve: str) -> dict | None:
        if self.df is None or cve not in self.df.index:
            return None
        r = self.df.loc[cve]
        return {"cve": cve, **{k: (None if isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v) else v) for k, v in r.items()}}

    def on_demand(self, cve: str, backend=None, fetch: bool = True, timeout: float = 10) -> dict | None:
        """CVE newer than the feed: fetch its NVD record, then LLM second opinion + HGB fallback."""
        if not fetch:
            return None
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(NVD_API.format(cve), timeout=timeout) as resp:
                vulns = json.load(resp).get("vulnerabilities", [])
        except Exception:
            return None
        if not vulns:
            return None
        rec = parse_record(vulns[0]["cve"], kev={})
        if rec is None:
            return None
        row = score_rows(pd.DataFrame([rec]), self.model(), backend).iloc[0].to_dict()
        row["source"] = row["source"] + "-on-demand"
        return {k: (None if isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v) else v) for k, v in row.items()}

"""scan -> feed lookup (or on-demand second opinion) -> priority rules -> report. Shared by CLI and API."""
from . import priority, report, scan
from .feed import Feed


def lookup_rows(cves: dict[str, dict], feed: Feed, fetch_missing: bool = False, backend=None) -> list[dict]:
    """One row per CVE with the fields priority.prioritise needs, plus package info from the scan."""
    rows = []
    for cve, pkg in sorted(cves.items()):
        rec = feed.get(cve) or (feed.on_demand(cve, backend) if fetch_missing else None)
        if rec is None:
            rows.append(dict(cve=cve, **pkg, source="not-in-feed", cna_vector=None, predicted_vector=None,
                             p_bump=None, epss=None, kev_date=None))
            continue
        rows.append(dict(cve=cve, **pkg, source=rec.get("source"), status=rec.get("status"),
                         cna_vector=rec.get("cna_vector"), predicted_vector=rec.get("predicted_vector"),
                         p_bump=rec.get("p_bump"), epss=rec.get("epss"), kev_date=rec.get("kev_date")))
    return rows


def run(text: str, filename: str, feed: Feed | None = None, *, write: bool = True, use_llm: bool | None = None,
        fetch_missing: bool = False, engine: str = "auto", index: dict | None = None, backend=None,
        report_tools=None) -> dict:
    """Full pipeline on lockfile content. Returns {rows, report_md, costs, data_as_of, engine, n_deps}."""
    feed = feed or Feed()
    sc = scan.scan_text(text, filename, engine=engine, index=index)
    rows = lookup_rows(scan.cves_by_package(sc["findings"]), feed, fetch_missing, backend)
    for r in rows:
        if r["source"] == "not-in-feed":
            r.setdefault("note", "not in the feed; no second opinion available")
    ranked = priority.prioritise_all(rows)
    for r in ranked:
        if r["source"] == "not-in-feed":
            r["reason"].insert(0, "not in the feed (no second opinion)")
    payload = report.build_payload(ranked, feed.data_as_of, feed.meta.get("epss_date"))
    if write:
        tools = report_tools if report_tools is not None else report.ToolContext(payload, feed)
        rep = report.write_report(payload, use_llm=use_llm, tools=tools)
    else:
        rep = dict(report_md="", writer="none", guardrail_ok=None, attempts=0, usd=0.0)
    return dict(rows=payload["rows"], counts=payload["counts"], report_md=rep["report_md"],
                costs=dict(usd=rep["usd"], writer=rep["writer"], guardrail_ok=rep["guardrail_ok"]),
                data_as_of=feed.data_as_of, engine=sc["engine"], n_deps=sc["n_deps"])

"""`patchsloth` CLI (SPEC §11.1)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import typer

from . import config

app = typer.Typer(help="Patch Sloth: a second opinion on CNA-only CVSS scores for the CVEs in your lockfile.",
                  no_args_is_help=True)
feed_app = typer.Typer(help="Build the nightly second-opinion feed.", no_args_is_help=True)
app.add_typer(feed_app, name="feed")


@app.command()
def scan(path: Path = typer.Argument(..., exists=True, help="Lockfile or project directory"),
         format: str = typer.Option("md", "--format", "-f", help="md | json"),
         no_llm: bool = typer.Option(False, "--no-llm", help="No LLM calls: NullBackend + template report"),
         no_report: bool = typer.Option(False, "--no-report", help="Rows only, no report"),
         engine: str = typer.Option("auto", help="auto | osv | fallback"),
         fetch_missing: bool = typer.Option(False, help="Fetch CVEs missing from the feed from the NVD API")):
    """Scan a lockfile or a project directory."""
    from . import service
    from .feed import Feed
    from .llm.backends import get_backend

    files = [path] if path.is_file() else [p for n in ("package-lock.json", "requirements.txt")
                                           if (p := path / n).exists()]
    if not files:
        raise typer.BadParameter(f"no package-lock.json or requirements.txt in {path}")
    feed = Feed()
    if feed.df is None:
        typer.echo("warning: no feed found; run `patchsloth feed build` first", err=True)
    backend = get_backend("null" if no_llm else None)
    for f in files:
        res = service.run(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), f.name, feed, write=not no_report,
                          use_llm=False if no_llm else None, engine=engine, fetch_missing=fetch_missing,
                          backend=backend)
        if format == "json":
            typer.echo(json.dumps(res, indent=1, default=str))
        elif no_report:
            for r in res["rows"]:
                typer.echo(f"{r['bucket']}  {r['cve']:<18} {r['package']}@{r['version']}  {'; '.join(r['reason'])}")
        else:
            typer.echo(res["report_md"])
        typer.echo(f"[{f.name}: {res['n_deps']} deps, engine={res['engine']}, writer={res['costs']['writer']}, "
                   f"cost=${res['costs']['usd']:.4f}]", err=True)


@app.command()
def cve(cve_id: str = typer.Argument(..., help="e.g. CVE-2026-12345")):
    """Single-CVE second opinion."""
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    from .api import create_app
    r = TestClient(create_app(rate_limit=10**6)).get(f"/cve/{cve_id}")
    typer.echo(json.dumps(r.json(), indent=1, default=str))
    raise typer.Exit(0 if r.status_code == 200 else 1)


@feed_app.command("build")
def feed_build(since: str = typer.Option(None, help="Only CVEs published on/after YYYY-MM-DD in the CSV"),
               no_llm: bool = typer.Option(True, "--no-llm/--llm", help="HGB-only (CPU) or with the LLM backend"),
               model: str = typer.Option("hgb", help="Bump model saved by scripts/07")):
    """Score unanalysed CVEs and write feed/second_opinion.parquet + feed/latest.csv.
    Rebuild data/cves.parquet first with scripts/01_download.py and scripts/02_build_dataset.py."""
    from .feed import build
    typer.echo(json.dumps(build(since=since, model_name=model, no_llm=no_llm), indent=1, default=float))


@app.command()
def serve(host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8080):
    """Run the API and web page locally."""
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run("patchsloth.api:app", host=host, port=port)


@app.command()
def costs():
    """Summarise results/costs.jsonl."""
    from .costs import summarise
    s = summarise()
    if not s:
        typer.echo(f"no costs logged yet ({config.RESULTS / 'costs.jsonl'})")
    typer.echo(json.dumps(s, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()

# M1 reproduction (CPU, 2026-10-21)

The refactored pipeline (`01_download.py` → `02` → `03` → `07 --model hgb|logreg`) was re-run on a Windows laptop with
conda, Python 3.11 and pandas 3.0. The data was downloaded on 2026-10-21 (`results/data_as_of.txt`). Reference
values come from SPEC §2/§8.3/§9.2 and the committed scaffold results.

## Dataset (`02`, `results/dataset_summary.txt`)

| Quantity | Reference | Now | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-rejected CVEs | 239,058 | 239,058 | 0 |
| train / val / test | 80,098 / 11,655 / 30,706 | 80,098 / 11,655 / 30,706 | 0 |
| deferred_unlabeled | 48,979 | 48,979 | 0 |
| Bump-up rate train / val / test | 0.182 / 0.227 / 0.093 | 0.182 / 0.227 / 0.093 | 0 |

The output is identical: today's fkie-cad release matches the snapshot the scaffold was built from, and the
refactored label rule and splits reproduce it exactly.

## Task A baselines (`03`, `results/baselines_{val,test}.json`)

| Split | Model | Severity acc (ref → now) | Exact vector | Bump F1 | Bump PR-AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| val | copy-CNA | 0.721 → 0.721 | 0.627 → 0.627 | 0 → 0 | — |
| val | TF-IDF + LR | 0.822 → 0.822 | 0.708 → 0.708 | 0.793 → 0.793 | 0.884 → 0.885 |
| test | copy-CNA | 0.882 → 0.882 | 0.809 → 0.809 | 0 → 0 | — |
| test | TF-IDF + LR | 0.836 → 0.836 | 0.709 → 0.708 | 0.562 → 0.559 | 0.517 → 0.517 |

McNemar vs copy-CNA (severity): val p = 7e-88 (LR better), test p = 8e-85 (copy-CNA better). Same direction as before.
The differences are ≤ 0.003 (solver/library versions).

## Task B bump classifier (`07`, `results/bump_{hgb,logreg}.json`)

| Model | Split | PR-AUC (ref → now) | 95% CI (now) | Precision top 10% (ref → now) | ROC-AUC | Brier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HistGBT | val | 0.898 → 0.898 | 0.889–0.908 | 0.967 → 0.967 | 0.960 | 0.061 |
| HistGBT | **test** | **0.580 → 0.580** | 0.561–0.599 | **0.529 → 0.529** | 0.903 | 0.059 |
| LogReg | test | 0.45 → 0.449 | 0.428–0.470 | — → 0.457 | 0.866 | 0.069 |

All the §9.2 bars are reproduced within ±2%. The HGB model is now seeded (`random_state=0`), and the FeatureBuilder
refactor (train-fitted vocabularies) did not move the numbers.

## Thresholds (new, `results/thresholds.json`)

τ is chosen as SPEC §9.2 says: the largest flagged set with precision ≥ 0.5 on the most recent 3 months of val
(published ≥ 2025-09-30, n = 5,614, base rate 0.191). τ_high uses precision ≥ 0.75 on the same window.

| | τ | τ_high |
|---|---|---|
| HGB | 0.072 | 0.442 |

falls short of the 0.5 target, because the 2026 base rate (0.093) is half that of the tuning window (0.191). The
threshold was not tuned on test. The options are recorded in DECISIONS.md.

"""Guardrail (SPEC §11.4): injected CVE IDs or numbers are caught; retry once; then template fallback."""
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

from patchsloth import report
from patchsloth.priority import prioritise_all

MED = "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N"
HIGH = "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H"


def payload():
    rows = prioritise_all([
        dict(cve="CVE-2026-1111", package="lodash", version="4.17.20", fixed="4.17.21", cna_vector=MED,
             predicted_vector=HIGH, p_bump=0.8213, epss=0.0123, kev_date=None, source="model"),
        dict(cve="CVE-2025-2222", package="jinja2", version="2.10", fixed=None, cna_vector=MED,
             predicted_vector=MED, p_bump=0.01, epss=None, kev_date=None, source="model"),
    ], tau=0.3, tau_high=0.7)
    return report.build_payload(rows, data_as_of="2026-10-21T14:41Z", epss_date="2026-10-21")


def facts():
    return json.dumps(payload())


def test_template_passes_guardrail():
    md = report.template_report(payload())
    ok, bad = report.guardrail(md, facts())
    assert ok, bad
    assert "CVE-2026-1111" in md and "estimates for triage" in md


def test_faithful_text_passes():
    text = ("Update lodash 4.17.20 to 4.17.21: CVE-2026-1111 is likely under-rated (p=0.82), "
            "CNA MEDIUM 5.4 vs predicted HIGH 7.5. Data as of 2026-10-21. 1. P0 table follows.")
    assert report.guardrail(text, facts()) == (True, [])


def test_fake_cve_is_caught():
    ok, bad = report.guardrail("Also patch CVE-2024-99999 right away.", facts())
    assert not ok and "CVE-2024-99999" in bad


def test_fake_number_is_caught():
    ok, bad = report.guardrail("CVE-2026-1111 scores 9.8 and is exploited by 37% of attackers.", facts())
    assert not ok and "9.8" in bad and "37" in bad


def test_fake_version_is_caught():
    ok, bad = report.guardrail("Upgrade lodash to 4.18.0.", facts())
    assert not ok and "4.18.0" in bad


def test_cve_digits_do_not_whitelist_numbers():
    ok, bad = report.guardrail("Score 1111.", facts())
    assert not ok and "1111" in bad


class FakeClient:
    """Mimics openai.OpenAI().chat.completions.create with canned answers."""

    def __init__(self, answers):
        self.answers, self.calls = list(answers), 0
        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))

    def _create(self, **kw):
        self.calls += 1
        assert kw["model"] == "ultramarine-1-flash" and kw["reasoning_effort"] == "low"
        msg = SimpleNamespace(content=self.answers.pop(0), tool_calls=None)
        usage = SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=1000, completion_tokens=200,
                                prompt_tokens_details=SimpleNamespace(cached_tokens=0))
        return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=msg, finish_reason="stop")], usage=usage)


def test_retry_then_template_fallback(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(report.costs, "COSTS_FILE", tmp_path / "costs.jsonl")
    monkeypatch.setattr(report.costs.log, "__defaults__", (tmp_path / "costs.jsonl",))
    client = FakeClient(["Patch CVE-2099-0001 now.", "It scores 9.9."])
    out = report.write_report(payload(), use_llm=True, client=client)
    assert client.calls == 2 and out["writer"] == "template-fallback" and out["guardrail_ok"] is False
    assert "CVE-2026-1111" in out["report_md"]
    logged = [json.loads(line) for line in open(tmp_path / "costs.jsonl")]
    assert [r["guardrail_ok"] for r in logged] == [False, False] and logged[0]["usd"] > 0


def test_retry_succeeds(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(report.costs.log, "__defaults__", (tmp_path / "costs.jsonl",))
    client = FakeClient(["Patch CVE-2099-0001 now.", "Patch CVE-2026-1111 (lodash 4.17.21)."])
    out = report.write_report(payload(), use_llm=True, client=client)
    assert out["writer"] == "ultramarine" and out["attempts"] == 2


def test_no_key_uses_template(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(report.config, "PAPERINSTRUMENTS_API_KEY", "")
    out = report.write_report(payload())
    assert out["writer"] == "template" and out["usd"] == 0.0

"""Join the GHSA index to the feed: npm/PyPI advisories whose CVE is currently Deferred."""
import pandas as pd

from patchsloth import scan

idx = scan.load_index()
feed = pd.read_parquet("feed/second_opinion.parquet").set_index("cve")
rows = []
for key, advs in idx.items():

        continue
    eco, name = key.split(":", 1)
    for a in advs:
        for c in a["cves"]:
            if c in feed.index and feed.at[c, "status"] == "Deferred":
                ev = [e for r in a["affected"].get("ranges", []) for e in r["events"]]
                rows.append(dict(eco=eco, name=name, ghsa=a["id"], cve=c, p=feed.at[c, "p_bump"],
                                 cna_vec=feed.at[c, "cna_vector"], events=ev))
d = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("deferred CVEs with npm/PyPI advisories:", d.cve.nunique(), "packages:", d.name.nunique())
print(d.groupby("eco").cve.nunique().to_dict())
pd.set_option("display.width", 250, "display.max_colwidth", 90)
for eco in ("npm", "PyPI"):
    print(d[d.eco == eco].sort_values("p", ascending=False).head(25).to_string())
print("skipped", idx.get("_meta"))

"""Build tests/fixtures from real data (SPEC §11.2): two lockfiles with known-vulnerable pins, the GHSA
advisories for exactly those packages, a mini feed for those CVEs, and expected.json (the CVE set the
fallback matcher finds against the FULL advisory index, so the fixture DB is checked to be complete).
Needs data/raw/advisory-database, data/advisory_index.json.gz and feed/second_opinion.parquet."""
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from patchsloth import config, scan

FIX = Path("tests/fixtures")
NPM = {"lodash": "4.17.20", "brace-expansion": "1.1.11", "ajv": "6.12.6", "vue": "2.7.16", "ms": "2.1.3"}
PYPI = {"jinja2": "2.10", "requests": "2.31.0", "gradio": "5.20.0", "six": "1.16.0"}

lock = {"name": "patchsloth-fixture", "version": "1.0.0", "lockfileVersion": 3, "requires": True,
        "packages": {"": {"name": "patchsloth-fixture", "version": "1.0.0",
                          "dependencies": {k: f"^{v}" for k, v in NPM.items() if k != "brace-expansion"}}}}
for name, ver in NPM.items():
    key = f"node_modules/{name}" if name != "brace-expansion" else "node_modules/minimatch/node_modules/brace-expansion"
    lock["packages"][key] = {"version": ver, "resolved": f"https://registry.npmjs.org/{name}/-/{name}-{ver}.tgz"}
lock["packages"]["node_modules/minimatch"] = {"version": "3.1.2", "dependencies": {"brace-expansion": "^1.1.7"}}

FIX.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(FIX / "package-lock.json").write_text(json.dumps(lock, indent=2) + "\n")
(FIX / "requirements.txt").write_text("# known-vulnerable pins for tests (do not install)\n"
                                      + "".join(f"{k}=={v}\n" for k, v in PYPI.items()))

full = scan.load_index()
expected, cves, ghsa = {}, set(), set()
for fname in ("package-lock.json", "requirements.txt"):
    res = scan.scan_text((FIX / fname).read_text(), fname, engine="fallback", index=full)
    found = sorted({c for f in res["findings"] for c in f["cves"]})
    expected[fname] = dict(cves=found, fixed={f["package"]: f["fixed"] for f in res["findings"]})
    cves |= set(found)
    ghsa |= {f["advisory"] for f in res["findings"]}
# also copy every (non-matching) advisory of these packages, so "not affected" paths are exercised
for eco, pkgs in (("npm", NPM), ("PyPI", PYPI)):
    for name in pkgs:
        ghsa |= {a["id"] for a in full.get(f"{eco}:{name}", [])}

adv_out = FIX / "advisories"
shutil.rmtree(adv_out, ignore_errors=True)
for g in sorted(ghsa):
    src = next(config.ADVISORY_DB.glob(f"*/*/{g}/{g}.json"))
    dst = adv_out / src.relative_to(config.ADVISORY_DB)
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
